$comment: Example spec for Sigil.exe --headless mt-bench (see scripts/mt-bench/README.md). Paths are relative to this file.
nllb: the in-process engine of the app; the model comes from the model store of SIGIL_APP_DATA_DIR (Sigil.exe --headless fetch mt/nllb-200-distilled-600m-int8) or a folder given as "path".

openai: any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions server (llama-server, Ollama, LM Studio, a cloud API); a key, when the server needs one, comes from the environment variable named by "apiKeyEnv", never from this file. Remove the entry when no server runs: a failed engine is reported, the rest still run.
hypotheses: a JSON-lines file of {"id", "hyp"} produced elsewhere (e.g. the Bergamot helper), scored without latency.
